sections.Profile:
Shark, released by A. Hankin & Co. in 1980, is a widebody solid-state pinball machine with an oceanic theme centered around shark encounters.

- Manufacturer: A. Hankin & Co.
- Years made: 1980
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Sharks, Original Theme, Surfing, Solid State, Widebody, Water, 1980s
